_note: Furniture for the player's homes (systems/furnishing.js, world/innerMap/furnishing.js). Each piece draws with an interior furniture type (its art in innerMapRenderer.json → interiorArt.furniture, its glyph in ui/icons.js) and does what that type does (ui/objectActions/data.js FURNITURE_ACTIONS: a bed sleeps, a chest stores, a hearth cooks). footprint [w, h] in tiles; a piece longer one way turns (R) to lie the other. minSettlement: the smallest place whose furniture maker makes it. comfort: added to the comfort need each hour spent in a home it stands in (all pieces together capped at comfortCap). restBonus: a bed's sleep restores this much more (0.2 = +20%). maker: who makes it (makers below; the shop groups by maker). kind: "decor" is a small thing set on a table, desk, shelf, dresser or counter (decorOn), its look tile._decor = decor; "wall" is hung on a wall facing into a room, tile._wallDecor = wallDecor (onWindow: at a window only). Decor adds comfort, cheer (fun each hour at home), light and prestige (each guest well received at home), all of it together capped at decorCap. A window is not sold: it is building work (windowJob), knocked through a bare wall of your home.

windowJob.name: Window
windowJob.desc: A mason knocks a window through a bare wall of your home and glazes it with horn.
